what_iterations_1_and_2_established.conclusion_carried_forward: A TRAILING lock (floor = HWM*(1-trail_pct)) clips runners because it exits on premium PULLBACK, which on 0DTE is often theta rather than reversal. The prior iteration-2 pre-reg explicitly named 'BE floor instead of a trail' as a candidate for a future SEPARATE pre-reg, not tested by either prior run. THIS is that pre-reg.

hypothesis: profit_lock_mode="fixed" is a BREAKEVEN floor (exit_manager.py plan_exit_actions: pre-TP1 arm sets runner_stop = max(runner_stop, entry); post-TP1, 'fixed' mode never ratchets further -- the trailing branch is skipped entirely), NOT a trail. A BE floor can only exit a position that returns ALL THE WAY to its entry price -- it structurally CANNOT clip a runner that stays above entry mid-trade, while it converts a round-trip-to-loss (yesterday's shape) into a scratch. This combination -- profit_lock_mode="fixed" + profit_lock_arm_scope="full" (arm pre-TP1) -- has NEVER been tested.
structural_note_disclosed_before_running: profit_lock_mode is read by BOTH the pre-TP1 arm_scope=full branch AND the post-TP1 runner branch (exit_manager.py:465-468). Because TP1 fill UNCONDITIONALLY resets runner_stop_premium=entry and profit_lock_armed=True regardless of arm_pct/arm_scope (exit_manager.py:442-444), switching profit_lock_mode to "fixed" ALSO removes the post-TP1 15%-trailing protection for any trade that reaches TP1 -- not just adding a pre-TP1 floor. This is a THIRD key changed (not two) relative to CONTROL, and a materially different (larger) structural change than iterations 1-2 (which held profit_lock_mode="trailing" fixed throughout and only moved arm_scope/arm_pct/tp1, so any trade reaching TP1 in those cells rode IDENTICALLY to CONTROL post-TP1 -- the runner-cohort damage in iterations 1-2 came entirely from trades knocked out PRE-TP1). Disclosed here, before any run, precisely because it changes what a 'runner cohort' result even means for this cell: a degradation here could come from a genuine pre-TP1 round-trip-to-entry (the mechanism the hypothesis predicts is rare) OR from the loss of post-TP1 trailing protection on trades that DO reach TP1 (a different, structural mechanism the hypothesis does not address). Both must be checked and reported separately -- see gates_frozen G4 detail requirement below.
